text:
alex: FYI bringing up gpu-region-5 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a security-baseline + handoff plan for the new GPU cluster. Key items: IAM roles, secrets handling, KMS/HSM integration, network policy checks, and cost gating. Ping @sec-team and @sana for review.

sana: Got it. I'll draft a minimal checklist we can run pre- and post-provisioning. Will need terraform outputs (service account emails, key ring names) and an exported plan.

david: IAM notes (short): use least-privilege service accounts, no wildcard roles for node pools. Example role binding we prefer:
```json
{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:gpu-node-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
```
Also create a separate SA for controllers vs runtime workloads.

jia: Secrets: put model keys/secrets into Vault (transit for dynamic encrypt/decrypt) or Cloud KMS-wrapped secrets, not plain env vars. Rotation policy: 90 days for service credentials, automatic rotation for ephemeral certs. For HSM: we need a dedicated HSM cluster in eu-west3; sec-team, do we have a provisioning window to issue attestation certs?

infra-bot: deployment-scheduler: gpu-region-5 build queued (plan-id: plan-2026-03-19-07). Smoke tests will run after nodepool creation.

sec-team: @jia we have a 2-hr window after midnight UTC tomorrow to provision the HSM and register keys. Requirements for key policy: deny plaintext export, limit decrypt to specific SA principals, and include org-restrict condition. Sample key policy snippet:
```json
{"bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:gpu-controller@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}],"denyExport":true}
```
We also require CC AOC entry for the HSM instance.

sana: Handoff checklist (pre-provision):
- Terraform plan and full diff attached
- Confirm VPC/subnet private ranges and NAT/egress egress points
- KMS key ring created with alias `projects/proj/locations/eu-west3/keyRings/gpu-region-5`
- Service accounts created: `gpu-node-sa`, `gpu-controller`, `model-runner`
- Vault paths created: `secret/gpu-region-5/models/*` with ACLs

Handoff checklist (post-provision validations):
- `kubectl get nodes` all Ready and labelled `gpu=true`
- KMS encrypt/decrypt test passes from a pod
- Vault transit encrypt/decrypt roundtrip
- IAM policy scan (least-priv) passes (run `policy-scan --target gpu-region-5`)
- Network policy enforced for default namespace
- Cost budget alert created and tested

sana: Acceptance criteria for security signoff: all above validations green, HSM attestation uploaded, and sec-team approval in JIRA.

alex: Cost constraints: target amortized infra cost ~ $0.45–0.70 per vGPU-hour depending on spot vs reserved. Put a hard budget of $15k/month initial, with alerts at 50%/75%/90%. If burning >75% in first 72h, auto-disable new job scheduling (policy).

david: Network quick notes: use private cluster with master authorized networks, disable public node IPs. Egress through managed NAT with egress tagging. Example VPC route snippet for peering: 
```bash
# VPC peering routes
gcloud compute networks peerings create gpu-to-prod --network=gpu-vpc --peer-project=prod --peer-network=prod-vpc
```
Also enforce egress firewall rules: only allow to artifact storage, model registry, KMS endpoints.

jia: Validation commands (to run during smoke):
```bash
kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=gpu=true
kubectl run kms-test --image=google/cloud-sdk --command -- bash -c "echo test | gcloud kms encrypt --location=eu-west3 --keyring=gpu-region-5 --key=model-key --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=-"
# Vault transit example (from pod): vault write transit/encrypt/gpu-region-5 plaintext=$(base64 <<<"hello")
```

sec-team: We'll create a quick checklist in JIRA (SEC-1245) and schedule a 30-min review after smoke tests. Approval flow: sec-team review -> infra lead signoff -> prod-sre baseline check. If any IAM or KMS test fails, we fail open to manual remediation, not auto-promote. :thumbsup:

alex: Fine. I'll attach terraform plan + tags to the thread: `gpu-region-5-2026-03-19`. If anyone hits blockers during early bring-up call out here ASAP and ping @infra-oncall.

infra-bot: smoke-tests started (run-id: s-2026-03-19-01). Results will post here when finished.

sana: I'll collate results and post a short report when smoke completes. Thanks all.
